Context: 6. Benefit of Two HRAs

out of NER, A&N, Lakshadweep and Ladakh before 1-7-2017.  
The benefit of two HRAs is admissible also to those employees who on their transfer keep their families in the previous station in own / hired accommodation after vacating Government accommodation due to their transfer to N-E. Region, etc. - Para. (vii), Part-Ill, Appendix 9.
